column1: # Ion-size parameters (a0, angstrom) of aqueous species for the B-dot and Debye-Hueckel activity models,
# with EQ3/6's activity-coefficient flag (0: B-dot, -1: nonpolar neutral, ln gamma from the CO2 model).
# Numbers only, read from the EQ3/6 v8.0a composite database data0.cmp (data0.com.V8.R6; LLNL, Wolery,
# github.com/LLNL/EQ3_6, BSD-3-Clause), as Reaction used them when that file was installed; the sizes
# themselves are the published values EQ3/6 compiles (Helgeson 1969; Kielland 1937 and later). Extracted
# with Douglas's approval on 2026-11-04 so that the app needs no copy of the database. No log K values.
# Species names are as in data0 (Ca++, SO4--); reaction.thermo.eosdb maps them to OBIGT spellings.
